contact_cleaner_subtitle: Standardize numbers and remove duplicates directly from your device
contact_cleaner_platform_not_supported_s: This build supports Android and iOS only.
contact_cleaner_permission_required_subt: Allow contacts access so the app can analyze and clean your contact list.
contact_cleaner_apply_completed: Fixes were applied and the device was scanned again.
contact_cleaner_auto_clean_preset_update: Settings were updated to the suggested auto-clean mode.
contact_cleaner_delete_rule_message: Analysis will run again immediately after deletion.
contact_cleaner_apply_confirmation_messa: Review the preview first. It is recommended to create a backup before applying changes to the address book.
contact_cleaner_header_subtitle: The app scans contacts directly from your device, standardizes numbers, detects duplicates, and shows a preview before any real modification.
contact_cleaner_changes_ready_note: Changes are ready for review. Check the Preview tab before the final apply step.
contact_cleaner_no_changes_note: No contact will be modified before preview and confirmation. If no changes appear, the current rules did not produce any actionable fixes.
contact_cleaner_no_result_subtitle: Start scanning contacts to view statistics and detected issues.
contact_cleaner_no_issues_message: No formatting issues or incomplete numbers were found.
contact_cleaner_issues_visible: Showing {visible} of {total} numbers that need review or a matching rule.
contact_cleaner_no_formatting_subtitle: Existing numbers are already international or match the current rules.
contact_cleaner_no_duplicates_data_subti: The duplicates report will appear after the first scan.
contact_cleaner_duplicates_report_summar: Showing {visible} of {total} duplicate groups. Across contacts: {cross}, within a single contact: {within}.
contact_cleaner_no_duplicates_subtitle: No repeated numbers were detected across or within contacts.
contact_cleaner_no_changes_subtitle: Adjust rules or cleanup options, then review the preview here.
contact_cleaner_preview_visible: Showing {visible} of {total} actions ready to apply to the address book.
contact_cleaner_merge_subtitle: This contact will be kept and the remaining records will be merged into it.
contact_cleaner_rules_subtitle: Control how the app handles local numbers, duplicates within one contact, and duplicates across contacts.
contact_cleaner_option_normalize_title: Replace local number with international format
contact_cleaner_option_normalize_subtitl: Transforms the number after matching length and prefix rules.
contact_cleaner_option_within_contact_ti: Remove duplicates inside the same contact
contact_cleaner_option_within_contact_su: Keeps only one copy of a repeated number inside the same record.
contact_cleaner_no_rules_subtitle: Add a length/prefix rule to apply a country code to local numbers.
contact_cleaner_rule_example: Example: if the length is 10 and it starts with 05, add +966 and remove the leading 0.
contact_cleaner_rule_validation_error: Complete the rule name, length, and country code.
